plugins.name: plugins-bin-to-path
plugins.description: Puts each enabled Claude Code plugin's bin/ directory on the Bash tool PATH, so bundled executables run by bare name under omp.

plugins.name: pi-vim
plugins.description: Vim-style modal editing (NORMAL/INSERT) for the omp prompt editor. Esc for NORMAL, i/a/o for INSERT, hjkl/w/b/0/$/gg/G motions, x/dd/dw/D edits.

plugins.name: obsidian-welcome
plugins.description: Animated Obsidian-aware welcome screen that activates only when omp runs inside an Obsidian vault.

plugins.name: omp-permission-guard
plugins.description: Classifier-based tool-approval gate (heuristic / guardian / hybrid) for the oh-my-pi coding agent. Vendored from hank-warren, pinned to a reviewed commit in erikh3's fork.

plugins.name: context-injector
plugins.description: Inject skills and arbitrary file contents into the LLM context at agent-start time. Supports skill:// URIs (resolved via omp's active skill registry), filesystem paths, and globs. Configurable via context-injector.yml with per-entry once/display flags and both user and project scopes.

plugins.name: unslop-pr
plugins.description: TTSR rules that intercept PR creation and update calls (both xd://mcp write path and gh pr bash commands) and force the agent to load the unslop skill before writing PR titles or descriptions.

plugins.name: git-commit-linter
plugins.description: Validates model-issued git commit messages against commitlint rules before Bash executes. Enforces Conventional Commits by default; defers to repository commitlint config when present. Never intercepts user bang commands or terminal commits.

plugins.name: github-comment-guard
plugins.description: Blocks the AI agent from replying to human-authored GitHub review comments via MCP tools or gh CLI. Bot-authored replies and new top-level comments remain allowed. Gate is on by default; inspect or change it with /github-comment-gate [on|off].

plugins.name: hai-proxy-companion
plugins.description: Shows estimated HAI Proxy spend and context growth below the prompt. On DAILY_CAP_EXCEEDED, prints a cap-hit message and exits omp before the retry loop starts.
